episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares how he grew his real estate business from $12 million to $40 million by focusing on relationship-building through community events and targeted content. He emphasizes the importance of knowing your dream client and creating valuable, niche-specific content to stand out in a crowded market. Greg also discusses how to maintain work-life balance by delegating tasks and focusing on high-impact activities.
